# MTBI Subject Breakdown

```{r}
library(readr)
library(abcdutils)

# Change carbon path here
load_carbon <- function(path) {
    carbon_path <- "/home/prashanth/mnt/wheeler-lab/lab-data/abcd/"
    read_delim(paste0(carbon_path, path))
}

# NDA summary TBI dataset for baseline
abcd_tbi01 <- load_carbon("4.0/trauma/abcd_tbi01.txt") |>
    dplyr::filter(eventname == "baseline_year_1_arm_1")

# Non summary dataset
abcd_otbi01 <- load_carbon("4.0/trauma/abcd_otbi01.txt") |>
    dplyr::filter(eventname == "baseline_year_1_arm_1")

# Our TBI info assignment for all subjects at baseline
# The relevant columns are "mtbi" (did the person have an mTBI) and
#  "moderate_or_severe_tbi" (did the person have a moderate+ injury)
our_tbi_summary <- abcd_otbi01 |>
    scabcd::remove_dd() |>
    scabcd::rename_tbi() |>
    scabcd::identify_all_tbi()

# Merging dataframes and replacing NA (for no worst TBI) with 0
joint_tbi_summary <-
    dplyr::inner_join(our_tbi_summary, abcd_tbi01, by = "subjectkey")
joint_tbi_summary$tbi_ss_worst_overall[
    is.na(joint_tbi_summary$tbi_ss_worst_overall)] <- 0

# Dataframe of subjects that were flagged as having an injury by either approach
any_injured <- joint_tbi_summary[
    joint_tbi_summary$mtbi > 0 |
    joint_tbi_summary$moderate_or_severe_tbi > 0 |
    joint_tbi_summary$tbi_ss_worst_overall > 1, ]

# MODERATE TO SEVERE TBI ASSIGNMENT DIFFERENCES ===============================
# Which subjects were flagged as moderate / severe mTBI by either approach?
mod_sev_differences <- any_injured |>
    dplyr::filter(tbi_ss_worst_overall > 3 | moderate_or_severe_tbi > 1) |>
    dplyr::select(subjectkey, moderate_or_severe_tbi, tbi_ss_worst_overall)

mod_sev_differences

# 7 Subjects at baseline had a moderate or severe TBI. Both methods agreed.

# MTBI ASSIGNMENT DIFFERENCES =================================================
only_our_mtbis <- any_injured |>
    dplyr::filter(mtbi > 0 & tbi_ss_worst_overall < 2)
only_our_mtbis
# Nobody was flagged as having an mTBI by just us

only_their_mtbis <- any_injured |>
    dplyr::filter(mtbi == 0 &
    (tbi_ss_worst_overall == 2 | tbi_ss_worst_overall == 3))
only_their_mtbis
# One person was flagged as having an mTBI by just them.

only_their_mtbis$subjectkey

# "NDAR_INV7XUV8V0N" has no raw mTBI data, but is assigned as having had a
#  worst mTBI of BOTH 1 (no TBI) AND 3 (mTBI), and subsequently assigned as 3

our_mtbis <- any_injured |>
    dplyr::filter(mtbi == 1)

their_mtbis <- any_injured |>
    dplyr::filter(tbi_ss_worst_overall == 2 | tbi_ss_worst_overall == 3)


which(!(our_mtbis$subjectkey %in% their_mtbis$subjectkey))
which(!(their_mtbis$subjectkey %in% our_mtbis$subjectkey))

mismatches <- their_mtbis[c(347, 429), ]

mismatches

# First subject was addressed above.
# Second subject I assigned as more than mild due to the many unknown repeat
#  injuries.
```
